reviewed_by: Claude, based on an independently validated root cause and a scratch-Core reproduction
reason: A project worker whose serving application failed now exits after recording its failure, so Core's existing dead-owner reconciliation and recovery free the project. The selected tests cover the exit after the failure receipt, the retained hold for a startup failure and for a failure while closing, and close cleanup, on SQLite and PostgreSQL.
exclusions: No UI, frontend, native or browser changes. Process-level worker suites are not selected because locally they import the primary checkout, not this branch; the change was exercised end to end on a scratch Core. tests/v3/test_recovery_reconciliation.py::test_retained_prepared_worker_survives_host_detach_and_new_host_activates_saved_recovery fails identically on clean main locally.
